resources.string: Confirm it\'s you to back up your accounts
Confirm it\'s you to restore a backup on this phone
Confirm it\'s you to replace Hanako\'s settings
Confirm it\'s you to export your chat and account lists
Confirm it\'s you to export a chat
This isn\'t a Hanako settings file.
This is a full backup. Use Restore full backup instead.
This isn\'t a Hanako full backup.
This is a settings file. Use Import settings instead.
This file was made by a newer Hanako. Update Hanako and try again.
The file is incomplete or damaged.
There are no accounts to back up.
Not enough storage. Free up space and try again.
Couldn\'t write to that folder. Pick another one.
No connection to Telegram. Try again when you\'re online.
Something went wrong. Tap Details for more.
Saves your Hanako options as a JSON file you can share. It doesn\'t include messages or logins.
Locked and hidden chats, ghost exceptions, message filters and hidden users, OpenPGP keys, and per-account options. Contains chat and account IDs: don\'t share this file.
They stay hidden after a restore and open with the same code.
Settings exported with chat lists. Keep the file private.
Replace your Hanako settings with the ones from this file? Your current settings are saved first, so you can undo this for 24 hours.
Replace your Hanako settings with the ones from this file (Hanako %1$s)? Your current settings are saved first, so you can undo this for 24 hours.
Per-account options: %1$d of %2$d accounts in the file are on this phone.
Also replace per-chat lists (locks, exceptions, filters)
Put back the Hanako settings you had before the last import? Hanako restarts to apply them.
This backup will contain %1$s and your Hanako settings.
Saved %2$s to %1$s. Store it offline: anyone with this file and the password can open your accounts.
Saved %1$s. Store the file offline: anyone with it and the password can open your accounts.
A replaced account\'s old session on this phone stays in Settings → Devices; you can end it there.
Ready to restore %1$s. Hanako restarts to finish.
Restored %1$s. %2$d couldn\'t be restored: log in to them normally.
The backup couldn\'t be restored. Log in normally, or try the backup again.
If you used a passcode, set it again in Privacy and Security.
Write this passphrase down somewhere safe before you continue.
Too weak. Use 12 or more characters, or tap Generate passphrase.
Telegram asked us to wait. Resuming in %1$d s
You can hide this and keep using Hanako; the export continues in the notification. An interrupted export can\'t be resumed.
Another chat export is still running.
No app can open that folder. Find it in your file manager.
Export stopped. Keep the partial export or delete it?
Tip: Settings search finds Hanako pages, like \"ghost\" or \"backup\".
Works only with Stay offline turned on (above).
Streamer mode is on: names, photos and numbers are masked.
People won\'t see when you\'re online, typing or reading their messages, and you watch stories unseen. Replying to a chat still marks it as read.
Ghost mode is off for this account. You can turn it on in Hanako settings.
Deleted and edited messages are kept on this phone, media included.
Hanako\'s \"Switch to the fastest working proxy\" is on (Hanako → Device and data → Network): it picks the fastest proxy instead of the first that answers.
Proxy not responding, switched to %1$s (%2$d ms)
%1$d file couldn\'t be downloaded (marked in the export).
%1$d files couldn\'t be downloaded (marked in the export).
Notifications are off for Hanako, so keep this window open to see and cancel the export. An interrupted export can\'t be resumed.
This phone has no screen lock and Hanako has no passcode, so anyone holding it can do this. Set a screen lock in system settings.
This phone has no screen lock and Hanako has no passcode, so anyone holding it could copy your logins. Set a screen lock or a Telegram passcode first, then try again.
A restore was prepared but Hanako wasn\'t restarted within 30 minutes, so it was dropped. Nothing was changed; start the restore again.
Telegram asked to wait %1$s before more requests. Try the export again later.
%1$d account couldn\'t be included: its login data couldn\'t be read. Log in to it normally on the new phone.
%1$d accounts couldn\'t be included: their login data couldn\'t be read. Log in to them normally on the new phone.
